name: com.xpturn.contentlink
description: Scope-owned asset loading for Unity 6.6 content directories. Sprites, prefabs, scenes and audio are loaded by name and owned by a GameObject, scene or explicit scope that ends on its own, so a forgotten release costs a little peak memory instead of leaking forever. Includes serialized links with an inspector drawer, owned instances and content scenes, a build pipeline (profiles, build window, size-split archives for download, post-processing, command line) and an editor simulation that plays straight from the project without a build.
